prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need a tester/repair for an irrigation system, a commercial building (fire line, boiler, etc.), or a residential water service? That will change who to call.

In the meantime, here’s how to quickly find qualified backflow testers/repairers near Liberty, MO and what to check:

Where to look
- Contact the City of Liberty Water Department/Utilities and ask for a list of approved/certified backflow testers for Liberty service connections. Many cities keep a list or will accept the certificate filed by a tester.
- Search local plumbing, irrigation, or fire-protection companies in the Kansas City / Liberty area (Google Maps, Yelp, Angi, HomeAdvisor).
- Look for companies that advertise “backflow testing,” “cross-connection control,” or “backflow assembly repair.”

What to verify before hiring
- They are a certified backflow tester (ask for their current tester certification/license and ID number). Common credentials come from recognized backflow training programs — ask which program they completed and for proof.
- They will provide a written test report and will file/submit it to the City of Liberty (or tell you how to submit it).
- They carry insurance and offer a parts/labor warranty for repairs.
- For irrigation devices, confirm whether they will winterize/inspect related components as needed.

Typical companies to try (types)
- Local plumbing contractors that list backflow testing on their websites
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (often test irrigation backflows)
- Fire protection contractors (for fire-line assemblies)
- Large regional plumbing services (Roto-Rooter, local independent plumbers) — verify their tester certification

Estimated cost
- Annual test: commonly $50–$150 depending on device complexity and location.
- Repairs: price varies by parts and labor; ask for a written estimate before work.

If you tell me whether it’s irrigation, fire line, or domestic service — and give your ZIP or nearest cross streets — I can give more specific next steps and help draft a message to send to potential testers.
